about: A table that fills in cell by cell as each row (or column) is said, with ticks and crosses for yes and no and one row picked out: comparing things on several features, results, a timetable, a grid of cases.

rows.about: rows split by ;, cells by |; the first row is the header; yes and no become ✓ and ✗

fill.about: rows or columns: which way the table fills

highlight.about: a row (by its first cell) or a cell to pick out

when.about: moments each row (or column) fills; else when its first cell is said, or one after another
